title: Category landing with mega-menu, promo banners and product carousels — fashion store
notes: v2 is a headless (Vite + CSS modules) rebuild. The primary navigation and mega-menus move into <ml-mega-nav>'s shadow root with a 'Featured' column first, re-ordered Clothing links and new URLs; a hidden mobile drawer and the Men menu also contain 'Knitwear' links. The hero CTA now reads 'Discover the edit' while a new 'Party Edit' module reuses 'Shop the edit'. Bestsellers now precedes New In and also features the Wool-Blend Wrap Coat at the same price; carousel arrows are relabelled 'Next slide'. The bag icon link becomes a drawer-toggle button, and the newsletter form moves to the footer (a hidden popup adds another email field).
